#Q2 To what extent does ancestry predict trait and trait plasticity?

##2.1. Estimate the genetic values of traits per genotypes (BLUPS)

###2.1.1 Estimating  traits values per garden (BLUPs)
```{r}
#define traits

traits <- c(
  
  # Leaf morphology
  "log_Dry_mass",
  "log_Area_m2",
  "LMA_g_m2",
  
  # Gas exchange
  "log_gsw",
  
  # Photochemistry
  "PS2",
  "ETR",
  "Fs",
  "log_Fm",
  
  # Stomatal patterning
  "PL_U",
  "PL_L",
  "SD_upper",
  "SD_lower",
  "SDR",
  "Ocurrence_upper",
  
  # Isotopes and nutrient-use traits
  "d13C",
  "C",
  "d15N",
  "N",
  "CN"
)



# Traits fitted on the log scale.
# These will be exponentiated after predictions are obtained.

log_traits <- c(
  "log_Dry_mass",
  "log_Area_m2",
  "log_gsw",
  "log_Fm"
)


# Binary trait.
# This will be modeled with a binomial GLMM.

binary_traits <- c(
  "Ocurrence_upper"
)



# create empty list
models <- list()
genotype_garden_results <- list()
gxe_structure_results<-list()



# LOOP THROUGH TRAITS


for (trait in traits) {
  
   dat_trait <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[trait]]),
      !is.na(GARDEN),
      !is.na(ID),
      !is.na(mblock)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      GARDEN = factor(GARDEN),
      ID = factor(ID),
      mblock = factor(mblock)
    )
  
  
  # Check binary trait

  
  if (trait %in% binary_traits) {
    
    cat("Binary trait values:\n")
    
    print(
      table(dat_trait[[trait]])
    )
  }
  
  

  #Define model formula

  
  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait,
      " ~ 0 + GARDEN + ",
      "(0 + GARDEN | ID) + ",
      "(1 | mblock)"
    )
  )
  
  #Fit model

  if (trait %in% binary_traits) {
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Binary trait:
    # binomial generalized linear mixed model
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    mod <- glmer(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = dat_trait,
      family = binomial(link = "logit"),
      control = glmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        optCtrl = list(
          maxfun = 2e5
        )
      )
    )
    
  } else {
    

    # Continuous traits:
    # Gaussian linear mixed model

    mod <- lmer(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = dat_trait,
      REML = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  
  #Store model

  
  models[[trait]] <- mod
  
  
  
  
 #Extract fixed garden effects

  garden_fixed <- fixef(mod)
  
  
  #Extract genotype random effects

  id_re <- ranef(mod)$ID
  
  
  #Calculate genotype-specific garden values

    genotype_garden <- id_re %>%
    rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
    mutate(
      
      Vermont =
        GARDENVermont +
        garden_fixed["GARDENVermont"],
      
      Virginia =
        GARDENVirginia +
        garden_fixed["GARDENVirginia"]
    )
  
  
   #Back-transform log-transformed continuous traits
  if (trait %in% log_traits) {
    
    genotype_garden <- genotype_garden %>%
      mutate(
        
        Vermont =
          exp(Vermont),
        
        Virginia =
          exp(Virginia)
      )
  }
  
  

  #Convert binary trait from logit to probability

   
  if (trait %in% binary_traits) {
    
    genotype_garden <- genotype_garden %>%
      mutate(
        
        Vermont =
          plogis(Vermont),
        
        Virginia =
          plogis(Virginia)
      )
  }

  
    
  # Remove "log_" from output trait names
  # The values have already been returned
  # to their original biological scale.
  
  output_trait <- sub(
    "^log_",
    "",
    trait
  )
  
  

  # Keep and rename final columns

  genotype_garden <- genotype_garden %>%
    select(
      ID,
      Vermont,
      Virginia
    ) %>%
    rename(
      
      !!paste0(
        "Vermont_",
        output_trait
      ) := Vermont,
      
      !!paste0(
        "Virginia_",
        output_trait
      ) := Virginia,
      
    )
  
  

  # store trait-specific results

  genotype_garden_results[[trait]] <-
    genotype_garden
  
  
  
  
  #Extract genotype variance and cross-garden correlation


vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod))

# Genotype-level variance/covariance only
vc_ID <- vc %>%
  filter(grp == "ID")

# Variance among genotypes in Vermont
var_vermont <- vc_ID %>%
  filter(
    var1 == "GARDENVermont",
    is.na(var2)
  ) %>%
  pull(vcov)

# Variance among genotypes in Virginia
var_virginia <- vc_ID %>%
  filter(
    var1 == "GARDENVirginia",
    is.na(var2)
  ) %>%
  pull(vcov)

# Covariance/correlation between genotype effects
cross_garden <- vc_ID %>%
  filter(!is.na(var2))

cov_vermont_virginia <- cross_garden$vcov

cor_vermont_virginia <- cross_garden$sdcor


# Store results
gxe_structure_results[[trait]] <- data.frame(
  
  Trait = sub("^log_", "", trait),
  
  Var_Vermont = var_vermont,
  
  Var_Virginia = var_virginia,
  
  Cov_Vermont_Virginia =
    cov_vermont_virginia,
  
  Genotypic_correlation =
    cor_vermont_virginia
)
}


# COMBINE ALL TRAITS INTO ONE WIDE DATASET

garden_blups_results <- genotype_garden_results %>%
  reduce(
    full_join,
    by = "ID"
  )


gxe_structure_table <- bind_rows(
  gxe_structure_results
) %>%
  mutate(
  )

gxe_structure_table

#write.csv(  garden_blups_results,  "Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Genotype_Garden_BLUPs.csv",row.names = FALSE)


```
###2.1.2 Compare genotype garden-specific blups with means
```{r}
# Calculate observed means per genotype × garden

observed_means <- df %>%
  select(ID, GARDEN, all_of(traits)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(log_traits),
      exp
    )
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ sub("^log_", "", .x),
    all_of(log_traits)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, GARDEN) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(sub("^log_", "", traits)),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = GARDEN,
    values_from = all_of(sub("^log_", "", traits)),
    names_glue = "{GARDEN}_{.value}"
  )


# Convert BLUPs to long format
blups_long <- garden_blups_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c("Garden", "Trait"),
    names_pattern = "^(Vermont|Virginia)_(.*)$",
    values_to = "BLUP"
  )

# Convert observed means to long format
means_long <- observed_means %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c("Garden", "Trait"),
    names_pattern = "^(Vermont|Virginia)_(.*)$",
    values_to = "Observed_mean"
  )

# Join both datasets
comparison <- means_long %>%
  inner_join(
    blups_long,
    by = c("ID", "Garden", "Trait")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Observed_mean),
    !is.na(BLUP),
    is.finite(Observed_mean),
    is.finite(BLUP)
  )

correlation_results <- comparison %>%
  group_by(Trait, Garden) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Spearman_rho = if (
      n() >= 3 &&
      n_distinct(Observed_mean) > 1 &&
      n_distinct(BLUP) > 1
    ) {
      cor(
        Observed_mean,
        BLUP,
        method = "spearman"
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(correlation_results)

write.csv(correlation_results, "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Correlation_BLUPS_means.csv")


# Select only these trait × garden combinations
selected_data <- comparison %>%
  filter(
    (Trait == "C" & Garden == "Virginia") |
    (Trait == "d15N" & Garden == "Virginia") |
    (Trait == "Fs" & Garden == "Vermont") |
    (Trait == "ETR" & Garden == "Virginia")
  )

# Create individual plots
trait_plots <- list()

for (trait in c("C", "d15N", "Fs", "ETR")) {

  dat_plot <- selected_data %>%
    filter(Trait == trait)

  p <- ggplot(
    dat_plot,
    aes(x = Observed_mean, y = BLUP)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 2,
      color = "steelblue4"
    ) +
    stat_cor(
      method = "spearman",
      aes(label = after_stat(r.label)),
      label.x.npc = "left",
      label.y.npc = "top",
      size = 4
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(trait, unique(dat_plot$Garden), sep = " - "),
      x = "Observed genotype mean",
      y = "BLUP"
    )

  trait_plots[[trait]] <- p
}

# Combine into a 2 × 2 figure
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(
  trait_plots,
  ncol = 2
)

# Save as a single-page PDF
ggsave(
  "Observed_means_vs_BLUPs_selected_traits.pdf",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  units = "in"
)
```

###2.1.2 Estimating Plasticity 
####2.1.3 Plasticity index 

```{r}
  #         |Virginia - Vermont|
  # P = -----------------------------
  #         Virginia + Vermont
  #
 

traits_2 <- c(
  
  # Leaf morphology
  "Dry_mass",
  "Area_m2",
  "LMA_g_m2",
  
  # Gas exchange
  "gsw",
  
  # Photochemistry
  "PS2",
  "ETR",
  "Fs",
  "Fm",
  
  # Stomatal patterning
  "PL_U",
  "PL_L",
  "SD_upper",
  "SD_lower",
  "SDR",
  "Ocurrence_upper",
  
  # Isotopes and nutrient-use traits
  "d13C",
  "C",
  "d15N",
  "N",
  "CN"
)



 
# Calculate plasticity index for each trait
for (trait in traits_2) {
  
  virginia_col <- paste0("Virginia_", trait)
  vermont_col  <- paste0("Vermont_", trait)
  
  plasticity_col <- paste0("Plasticity_", trait)
  
  garden_blups_results[[plasticity_col]] <-
    (garden_blups_results[[virginia_col]] -
       garden_blups_results[[vermont_col]]) /
    (garden_blups_results[[virginia_col]] +
       garden_blups_results[[vermont_col]])
}

df2<-merge(df,garden_blups_results, by ="ID")


```


### 2.2 Linear mixed models
#### 2.2.1 Does genomic ancestry predicts traits?
```{r}
# Trait base names
traits_garden <- c(
  "Dry_mass", "Area_m2", "LMA_g_m2",
  "gsw", "d13C",
  "PS2", "Fm", "Fs", "ETR",
  "PL_L", "PL_U", "SD_lower",
  "SD_upper", "SDR", "Ocurrence_upper",
  "N", "d15N", "CN"
)

gardens <- c("Vermont", "Virginia")

trait_labels_garden <- list(
  
  "Dry_mass" =
    expression("Leaf dry mass (g)"),
  
  "Area_m2" =
    expression("Leaf area (" * m^2 * ")"),
  
  "LMA_g_m2" =
    expression("Leaf mass per area (" * g ~ m^{-2} * ")"),
  
  "gsw" =
    expression(
      "Stomatal conductance (" *
        mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} * ")"
    ),
  
  "d13C" =
    expression(
      "Water-use efficiency (" *
        delta^{13} * C ~ "\u2030" * ")"
    ),
  
  "PS2" =
    expression("Quantum efficiency in light"),
  
  "ETR" =
    expression(
      "Electron transport rate (" *
        mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} * ")"
    ),
  
  "Fs" =
    expression("Minimum fluorescence in light"),
  
  "Fm" =
    expression("Maximum fluorescence in light"),
  
  "PL_U" =
    expression(
      "Adaxial pore length (" *
        mu * m * ")"
    ),
  
  "PL_L" =
    expression(
      "Abaxial pore length (" *
        mu * m * ")"
    ),
  
  "SD_upper" =
    expression(
      "Adaxial stomatal density (" *
        mm^{-2} * ")"
    ),
  
  "SD_lower" =
    expression(
      "Abaxial stomatal density (" *
        mm^{-2} * ")"
    ),
  
  "SDR" =
    expression("Stomatal ratio"),
  
  "Ocurrence_upper" =
    expression("Adaxial stomatal occurrence"),
  
  "N" =
    expression("Nitrogen content (%)"),
  
  "CN" =
    expression("Carbon:Nitrogen ratio"),
  
  "d15N" =
    expression(
      "Nitrogen isotopes (" *
        delta^{15} * N ~ "\u2030" * ")"
    )
)

# Store plots
plots_garden <- list(
  Vermont = list(),
  Virginia = list()
)


# Store model results
model_results_garden <- data.frame(
  Garden = character(),
  Trait = character(),
  Best_model = character(),
  R2 = numeric(),
  AdjR2 = numeric(),
  AIC_linear = numeric(),
  AIC_quadratic = numeric(),
  Delta_AIC = numeric(),
  Linear_Estimate = numeric(),
  Linear_p = numeric(),
  Quadratic_Estimate = numeric(),
  Quadratic_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Loop through gardens
for (garden in gardens) {
  
  # Loop through traits
  for (trait in traits_garden) {
    
    # Create actual column name
    trait_col <- paste0(garden, "_", trait)
    
    if (!trait_col %in% names(df2)) {
      warning(paste("Trait not found:", trait_col))
      next
    }
    
    
    # Data for this garden/trait
    df_plot <- df2 %>%
      dplyr::select(
        P_trichocarpa_ancestry,
        all_of(trait_col)
      ) %>%
      na.omit()
    
    
    # Linear model
    lm_lin <- lm(
      reformulate(
        "P_trichocarpa_ancestry",
        response = trait_col
      ),
      data = df_plot
    )
    
    
    # Quadratic model
    lm_quad <- lm(
      as.formula(
        paste0(
          trait_col,
          " ~ poly(P_trichocarpa_ancestry, 2)"
        )
      ),
      data = df_plot
    )
    
    
    # Compare AIC
    aic_lin  <- AIC(lm_lin)
    aic_quad <- AIC(lm_quad)
    
    delta_aic <- aic_lin - aic_quad
    
    
    # Select model
    if (delta_aic > 2) {
      best_model <- lm_quad
      model_type <- "quadratic"
    } else {
      best_model <- lm_lin
      model_type <- "linear"
    }
    
    
    # R2
    sm <- summary(best_model)
    
    r2 <- sm$r.squared
    adjr2 <- sm$adj.r.squared
    
    
    # Linear coefficient
    lin_coef <- summary(lm_lin)$coefficients
    
    lin_est <- lin_coef[2, "Estimate"]
    lin_p   <- lin_coef[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    
    
    # Quadratic coefficient
    quad_coef <- summary(lm_quad)$coefficients
    
    quad_est <- quad_coef[3, "Estimate"]
    quad_p   <- quad_coef[3, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    
    
    # P-value corresponding to selected model
    best_p <- if (model_type == "linear") {
      lin_p
    } else {
      quad_p
    }
    
    
    # Significance stars
    stars <- ifelse(
      best_p < 0.001, "***",
      ifelse(
        best_p < 0.01, "**",
        ifelse(best_p < 0.05, "*", "")
      )
    )
    
    
    # Save model results
    model_results_garden <- rbind(
      model_results_garden,
      data.frame(
        Garden = garden,
        Trait = trait,
        Best_model = model_type,
        R2 = r2,
        AdjR2 = adjr2,
        AIC_linear = aic_lin,
        AIC_quadratic = aic_quad,
        Delta_AIC = delta_aic,
        Linear_Estimate = lin_est,
        Linear_p = lin_p,
        Quadratic_Estimate = quad_est,
        Quadratic_p = quad_p
      )
    )
    
    
    # Subtitle
    subtitle_text <- paste0(
      "R² = ",
      sprintf("%.2f", r2),
      stars
    )
    
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(
      df_plot,
      aes(
        x = P_trichocarpa_ancestry,
        y = .data[[trait_col]]
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(fill = P_trichocarpa_ancestry),
        shape = 21,
        size = 3,
        alpha = 0.8,
        color = "black",
        stroke = 0.3
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        midpoint = 0.5,
        low = "dodgerblue2",
        mid = "grey20",
        high = "darkolivegreen2",
        space = "Lab"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = expression(
          italic("P. trichocarpa") ~ "ancestry"
        ),
        y = trait_labels_garden[[trait]],
        subtitle = subtitle_text
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          color = "black",
          size = 10
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          color = "black",
          size = 10
        ),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
          size = 14,
          color = "black"
        ),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
      )
    
    
    # Add selected model
    if (model_type == "linear") {
      
      p <- p +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = TRUE,
          color = "blue"
        )
      
    } else {
      
      p <- p +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ poly(x, 2),
          se = TRUE,
          color = "red"
        )
    }
    
    
    # Store plot
    plots_garden[[garden]][[trait]] <- p
  }
}


# Round model results
model_results_garden <- model_results_garden %>%
  mutate(
    R2 = round(R2, 2),
    AdjR2 = round(AdjR2, 2),
    AIC_linear = round(AIC_linear, 2),
    AIC_quadratic = round(AIC_quadratic, 2),
    Delta_AIC = round(Delta_AIC, 2),
    Linear_Estimate = round(Linear_Estimate, 3),
    Linear_p = signif(Linear_p, 3),
    Quadratic_Estimate = round(Quadratic_Estimate, 3),
    Quadratic_p = signif(Quadratic_p, 3)
  )


library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save all Vermont plots in one PDF
# and all Virginia plots in one PDF
# following the order in traits_garden
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (garden in gardens) {
  
  # Keep plots in exact trait order
  plot_list <- lapply(
    traits_garden,
    function(trait) {
      
      p <- plots_garden[[garden]][[trait]]
      
      if (is.null(p)) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      # Re-assign the y-axis title explicitly
      # so it is preserved in the combined figure
      p +
        labs(
          y = trait_labels_garden[[trait]]
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.title.y = element_text(
            size = 11,
            margin = margin(r = 8)
          ),
          plot.margin = margin(
            t = 8,
            r = 8,
            b = 8,
            l = 12
          )
        )
    }
  )
  
  
  # Remove missing plots
  plot_list <- plot_list[
    !sapply(plot_list, is.null)
  ]
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Number of columns
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ncol_plot <- 4
  
  nrow_plot <- ceiling(
    length(plot_list) / ncol_plot
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine with patchwork
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(
    plot_list,
    ncol = ncol_plot,
    nrow = nrow_plot
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PDF
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Ancestry_",
      garden,
      "_all_traits.pdf"
    ),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 18,
    height = nrow_plot * 3.5,
    units = "in",
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
  
  
  ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Ancestry_",
    garden,
    "_all_traits.png"
  ),
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = nrow_plot * 3.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 720
)
}

write.csv(model_results_garden, "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/model_results_gardens.csv")
```




#### 2.2.1 Does genomic ancestry predicts trait plasticty?

```{r}

traits_base <- c(
  "Dry_mass",
  "Area_m2",
  "LMA_g_m2",
  "gsw",
  "d13C",
  "PS2",
  "Fm",
  "Fs",
  "ETR",
  "PL_L",
  "PL_U",
  "SD_lower",
  "SD_upper",
  "SDR",
  "Ocurrence_upper",
  "N",
  "d15N",
  "CN"
)


# LABELS


trait_labels_base <- list(
  "Dry_mass" = "Leaf dry mass",
  "Area_m2" = bquote("Leaf area (" * m^2 * ")"),
  "LMA_g_m2" = bquote("Leaf mass per area (" * g ~ m^{-2} * ")"),
  "gsw" = bquote("Stomatal conductance (" * mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} * ")"),
  "d13C" = bquote("Water-use efficiency (" * delta^13 * C ~ "\u2030" * ")"),
  "PS2" = "Quantum efficiency in light",
  "Fm" = "Maximum fluorescence in light",
  "Fs" = "Minimum fluorescence in light",
  "ETR" = bquote("Electron transport rate (" * mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} * ")"),
  "PL_L" = bquote("Abaxial pore length (" * mu * m * ")"),
  "PL_U" = bquote("Adaxial pore length (" * mu * m * ")"),
  "SD_lower" = bquote("Abaxial stomatal density (" * mm^{-2} * ")"),
  "SD_upper" = bquote("Adaxial stomatal density (" * mm^{-2} * ")"),
  "SDR" = "Stomatal ratio",
  "Ocurrence_upper" = "Adaxial stomatal occurrence",
  "N" = "Nitrogen content (%)",
  "d15N" = bquote("Nitrogen isotopes (" * delta^15 * N ~ "\u2030" * ")"),
  "CN" = "Carbon:Nitrogen ratio"
)


# EMPTY OBJECTS


plots_all <- list()

model_results_all <- data.frame(
  Trait = character(),
  Variable = character(),
  Best_model = character(),
  R2 = numeric(),
  AdjR2 = numeric(),
  AIC_linear = numeric(),
  AIC_quadratic = numeric(),
  Delta_AIC = numeric(),
  Linear_Estimate = numeric(),
  Linear_p = numeric(),
  Quadratic_Estimate = numeric(),
  Quadratic_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# LOOP OVER TRAITS


for (trait in traits_base) {
  
  variable <- paste0("Plasticity_", trait)
  
  if (!variable %in% names(df2)) {
    warning(paste("Variable not found:", variable))
    next
  }
  

  # Prepare data

  
  df_plot <- df2 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      P_trichocarpa_ancestry,
      all_of(variable)
    ) %>%
    na.omit()
  

  # Fit linear and quadratic models

  
  lm_lin <- lm(
    as.formula(
      paste(variable, "~ P_trichocarpa_ancestry")
    ),
    data = df_plot
  )
  
  lm_quad <- lm(
    as.formula(
      paste(variable, "~ poly(P_trichocarpa_ancestry, 2)")
    ),
    data = df_plot
  )
  

  # Compare AIC

  
  aic_lin <- AIC(lm_lin)
  aic_quad <- AIC(lm_quad)
  
  delta_aic <- aic_lin - aic_quad
  
  if (delta_aic > 2) {
    best_model <- lm_quad
    model_type <- "quadratic"
  } else {
    best_model <- lm_lin
    model_type <- "linear"
  }
  

  # Model statistics

  
  sm <- summary(best_model)
  
  r2 <- sm$r.squared
  adjr2 <- sm$adj.r.squared
  
  lin_coef <- summary(lm_lin)$coefficients
  
  lin_est <- lin_coef[2, "Estimate"]
  lin_p <- lin_coef[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  quad_coef <- summary(lm_quad)$coefficients
  
  quad_est <- quad_coef[3, "Estimate"]
  quad_p <- quad_coef[3, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  best_p <- if (model_type == "linear") {
    lin_p
  } else {
    quad_p
  }
  
  stars <- ifelse(
    best_p < 0.001, "***",
    ifelse(
      best_p < 0.01, "**",
      ifelse(best_p < 0.05, "*", "")
    )
  )
  

  # Save results

  
  model_results_all <- rbind(
    model_results_all,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Variable = variable,
      Best_model = model_type,
      R2 = r2,
      AdjR2 = adjr2,
      AIC_linear = aic_lin,
      AIC_quadratic = aic_quad,
      Delta_AIC = delta_aic,
      Linear_Estimate = lin_est,
      Linear_p = lin_p,
      Quadratic_Estimate = quad_est,
      Quadratic_p = quad_p
    )
  )
  

  # Subtitle

  
  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "R² = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", r2),
    stars
  )
  

  # Plot

  
  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = P_trichocarpa_ancestry,
      y = .data[[variable]]
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = P_trichocarpa_ancestry),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.8,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      midpoint = 0.5,
      low = "dodgerblue2",
      mid = "grey20",
      high = "darkolivegreen2",
      space = "Lab"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      x = expression(
        italic("P. trichocarpa") ~ "ancestry"
      ),
      y = trait_labels_base[[trait]],
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 13,
        color = "black"
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  

  # Add selected model

  
  if (model_type == "linear") {
    
    p <- p +
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        formula = y ~ x,
        se = TRUE,
        color = "blue"
      )
    
  } else {
    
    p <- p +
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        formula = y ~ poly(x, 2),
        se = TRUE,
        color = "red"
      )
  }
  

  # Save plot

  
  plots_all[[trait]] <- p
}


# ROUND RESULTS


model_results_all <- model_results_all %>%
  mutate(
    R2 = round(R2, 2),
    AdjR2 = round(AdjR2, 2),
    AIC_linear = round(AIC_linear, 2),
    AIC_quadratic = round(AIC_quadratic, 2),
    Delta_AIC = round(Delta_AIC, 2),
    Linear_Estimate = round(Linear_Estimate, 3),
    Linear_p = signif(Linear_p, 3),
    Quadratic_Estimate = round(Quadratic_Estimate, 3),
    Quadratic_p = signif(Quadratic_p, 3)
  )


# SAVE RESULTS


write.csv(model_results_all,"Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Plasticity_results.csv",row.names = FALSE)



# COMBINE PLASTICITY INDEX PLOTS


combined_plot_index <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = plots_all,
  ncol = 4,
  nrow = 5,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right"
)

combined_plot_index


ggsave(
  filename = "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/PlasticityIndex_vs_Ancestry.png",
  plot = combined_plot_index,
  width = 18,
  height = 17.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 720
)
```

#Plot reaction norms per trait

```{r}
# 1. Create genotypic classes


df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    Genotypic_class = case_when(
      P_trichocarpa_ancestry <= 0.02 ~ "balsam_parental",
      P_trichocarpa_ancestry >= 0.98 ~ "tricho_parental",
      TRUE ~ "Hybrids"
    )
  )

table(df2$Genotypic_class)



# 2. Traits


traits <- c(
  "Dry_mass",
  "Area_m2",
  "LMA_g_m2",
  "gsw",
  "d13C",
  "PS2",
  "Fm",
  "Fs",
  "ETR",
  "PL_L",
  "PL_U",
  "SD_lower",
  "SD_upper",
  "SDR",
  "Ocurrence_upper",
  "N",
  "d15N",
  "CN"
)



# 3. Y-axis labels


trait_labels <- list(
  
  "Dry_mass" = "Leaf dry mass (g)",
  
  "Area_m2" = bquote(
    "Leaf area (" * m^2 * ")"
  ),
  
  "LMA_g_m2" = bquote(
    "Leaf mass per area (" * g ~ m^{-2} * ")"
  ),
  
  "gsw" = bquote(
    "Stomatal conductance (" * mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} * ")"
  ),
  
  "d13C" = bquote(
    delta^13 * C ~ ("\u2030")
  ),
  
  "PS2" = expression(Phi[PSII]),
  
  "Fm" = expression(F[m]),
  
  "Fs" = expression(F[s]),
  
  "ETR" = "Electron transport rate",
  
  "PL_L" = "Pore length, lower surface",
  
  "PL_U" = "Pore length, upper surface",
  
  "SD_lower" = bquote(
    "Stomatal density, lower (" * mm^{-2} * ")"
  ),
  
  "SD_upper" = bquote(
    "Stomatal density, upper (" * mm^{-2} * ")"
  ),
  
  "SDR" = "Stomatal density ratio",
  
  "Ocurrence_upper" = "Adaxial stomatal occurrence",
  
  "N" = "Leaf nitrogen (%)",
  
  "d15N" = bquote(
    delta^15 * N ~ ("\u2030")
  ),
  
  "CN" = "C:N ratio"
)



# 4. Create reaction-norm plots


reaction_norm_plots <- list()

for (trait in traits) {
  
  vt_col <- paste0("Vermont_", trait)
  va_col <- paste0("Virginia_", trait)
  
  # Skip trait if columns are missing
  if (!all(c(vt_col, va_col) %in% names(df2))) {
    message("Skipping ", trait, ": columns not found")
    next
  }
  
  # Reshape to long format
  df_reaction <- df2 %>%
    select(
      ID,
      Genotypic_class,
      P_trichocarpa_ancestry,
      all_of(c(vt_col, va_col))
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(c(vt_col, va_col)),
      names_to = "Garden",
      values_to = "Trait_value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Garden = case_when(
        Garden == vt_col ~ "Vermont",
        Garden == va_col ~ "Virginia"
      ),
      Garden = factor(
        Garden,
        levels = c("Virginia", "Vermont")
      )
    )
  
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    df_reaction,
    aes(
      x = Garden,
      y = Trait_value,
      group = ID
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_line(
      alpha = 0.5,
      aes(color = P_trichocarpa_ancestry)
    ) +
    
    geom_point(
      aes(color = P_trichocarpa_ancestry),
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    
    scale_color_gradient2(
      midpoint = 0.5,
      low = "dodgerblue2",
      mid = "grey20",
      high = "darkolivegreen2",
      space = "Lab"
    ) +
    
    facet_grid(
      ~ Genotypic_class,
      labeller = labeller(
        Genotypic_class = c(
          "balsam_parental" = "italic(P.~balsamifera)",
          "Hybrids" = "Hybrids",
          "tricho_parental" = "italic(P.~trichocarpa)"
        ),
        .default = label_parsed
      )
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = trait_labels[[trait]]
    ) +
    
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 10
      ),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 11
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  
  # Save plot object
  reaction_norm_plots[[trait]] <- p
}



# Save all reaction norm plots
# One trait per page


ggsave(
  filename = "Scripts and Data/Q2_TraitVariation_Plasticity_Ancestry/Reaction_norms_all_traits.pdf",
  plot = reaction_norm_plots,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# Themes to remove repeated elements

  strip.text = element_blank(),
  strip.background = element_blank()
)

  axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

  )

  axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )

# First column

# Combine all panels
```
